job.title: Senior Security Engineer - Detection & Response
job.pay_full: $141,600 – $212,400 a year base pay range for US locations; total compensation may also include the annual cash bonus plan, equity and sign-on payments

details.about: Klaviyo (pronounced clay-vee-oh) helps businesses make their own first-party customer data accessible and actionable, powering personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. Its growing Detection & Response team is engineering-first: this role covers the whole detection and response lifecycle, from building detections with software practices to triaging alerts, leading investigations, responding to incidents, threat hunting and building tooling, across Klaviyo's enterprise, cloud and product environments, with colleagues in several regions and time zones.
duties: Develop, test and deploy high-fidelity rule-based and anomaly-based detections as code
Detect and respond to cyber threats using a security data lake, SIEM and cloud platforms
Respond to alerts and drive end-to-end incident response investigations
Carry out digital forensic investigations, including collecting and analysing evidence
Automate and codify detection and response workflows, and build security tooling for the D&R lifecycle
Improve and maintain detection and response pipelines and the systems behind them
Work with the Threat Intelligence team on sophisticated threats
Develop AI-first security systems to automate detection and response
Run threat hunts across corporate, cloud and product environments
Support data engineering workflows for the security data lake and SIEM
Take part in D&R on-call rotations, and coach and mentor security engineers on the team
needs: 5+ years of hands-on security experience in modern cloud environments
Experience triaging and responding to cyber threats
Experience in large-scale log analysis, incident response and/or digital forensics
Experience with centralized security data lakes and SIEM solutions
Hands-on experience writing detections as code
Solid data querying skills (e.g. SQL, Splunk)
Familiarity with large-scale data pipelines and data engineering techniques
Programming skills to automate and build (e.g. Python, Go or similar)
Proven experience with git/GitHub and CI/CD automation
Familiarity with threat actors' tactics, techniques and procedures
Experience on a detection and response or incident response on-call
An engineering-first and AI-first approach, a passion for continuous learning, strong oral and written communication, and a self-managing team player
details.benefits: Base pay range for US locations: $141,600 – $212,400 a year (the range covers all US locations; the offer depends on skills, experience, education or training and work location). Total compensation may also include the company's annual cash bonus plan, equity, sign-on payments and a comprehensive range of health, welfare and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility.
notes: May require up to 10% travel (for example new-hire onboarding, team meetings and industry events), coordinated in advance
Includes taking part in D&R on-call rotations
Klaviyo encourages candidates who are a close but not exact match to apply
Klaviyo never asks applicants for payment, bank details or personal financial information
